create_routed_experts_capturer: create a routed experts capturer to capture top-k expert routing decisions during model forward passes
get_global_experts_capturer: get the global routed experts capturer instance for accessing captured expert routing data
set_global_experts_capturer: set the global routed experts capturer to enable or disable expert routing capture
extract_routed_experts_from_meta_info: extract routed expert IDs from base64-encoded meta info in model responses
capture_routed_experts_layer: capture routed expert IDs for a specific transformer layer during a forward pass
